Big day for Polygon!

Polygon is now a fully regulated payments company. With the completion of the Coinme acquisition, Polygon Open Money Stack is now a U.S. regulated payments platform, with coverage across 48 states.

We’ve spent years building the infrastructure to move money onchain. Today, we have more of the infrastructure, licenses, technology and distribution to make that happen.

With Open Money Stack, teams can make onchain money movement seamless for people and businesses, bringing stablecoins into everyday payments.

And the first customers are putting it to work: @Tazapay for cross-border business payments, @Meshpay for account funding, @useToku for global payroll and Kira for U.S. dollar access.

Proud of everyone who made this happen. This is a massive milestone. And we are just getting started!!

note_tweet.text:
🚨 CharacterAI is gone, and every AI company exploiting its users should go bankrupt. There are a few lessons to be learned from this case:

I've been writing about CharacterAI since 2024, and it was clear from the start that their users' safety and well-being weren't their focus.

Even AFTER the various lawsuits alleging ties to teen suicides, I tested the platform again, and the company still relied on harmful practices, such as barely visible disclosures, emotional manipulation, predatory marketing tactics, and weak content safety guardrails.

AI companies should look at this case and learn that the "AI race" or any ambitious financial goal will not be accepted as an excuse to ignore safety, ethics, and legal compliance.

It's not 2022 anymore: people are watching, safety standards are getting stronger, and existing laws apply. If you try to harm users, you'll be found.

AI governance professionals and anyone drafting AI policies and regulations should learn that raising awareness, filing complaints and lawsuits, and enforcing the law work, and they shouldn't give up.

Even if it sometimes seems like those in AI are too powerful to challenge or stop, when smart people act together as a community and on multiple fronts, change eventually comes.

As I've said many times before: the future of AI does not exist yet; we are building it right now.

 👉 To learn more about AI safety, ethics, and governance, join my newsletter's 102,000+ subscribers below.
